title: What I Learned From My Failed $50m Business Partnership
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
description:
Get my 12 favorite biz ideas for 2024, with full launch plans included here: https://tkopod.co/youtubeD

In this video, I want to tell you about the hardest business partnership experience I've ever been through. The partnership started with great promise but quickly ran into issues due to unequal efforts and contributions. Despite initial success, tensions rose, and I was eventually pushed out of the business. 

This experience was incredibly painful, but it taught me valuable lessons about trust, communication, and resilience in business relationships. Ultimately, it led to new opportunities and a deeper understanding of what makes a partnership work.
